		icon = generic_forestry
		priority = 100
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = { NOT = { has_country_flag = won_prog_farm } }
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = won_tt_prog_cooldown
				NOT = { has_country_flag = won_prog_cd_farm }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			set_country_flag = won_prog_farm
			won_programme_costs = yes
			won_recalc_modifiers = yes
